raw.name: Cabinet
raw.description:
The Commons makes your human half prove it at a public kiosk: play the
terminal's little platformer, and it signs off that a person was here. The
game is the whole authentication. Teach the cabinet to sign for a session
that never happened.

The service is headless: it replays a recorded input stream, so play and
record locally first, then submit the recording here. Run the handout as
`cabinet play` to play (a/d move, w jump, j stomp, hold l for fine
movement, q to quit and save) -- it writes an input recording. Feed that
file to this endpoint in the `cabinet replay` format: a u32 big-endian
frame count, then that many per-frame input bytes.

> [!CONNECTION]
> https://cabinet-bbe3ecg3.challenge.2026.haruulzangi.mn
raw.author: bekkaze
